cand.title: Geneva Book Fair 2027
cand.excerpt: Strong airport-corridor mechanism, but low current accessibility due to committed venue.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Natacha Bayard, fair director, is a senior relationship and routing contact; Claire Damary, Salon du livre project officer, is the named exhibitor-facing operational contact with a public direct email. Nine Simon, artistic director, is a secondary programme contact. None is verified as the hotel contracting signatory. The actual fellowship accommodation purchaser and general housing decision-maker remain unconfirmed.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced for 24–28 February 2027 at Palexpo, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This is within the requested horizon. Dates are activity dates, corroborated by the June 2026 exhibition regulations, not publication dates. No official 2028 dates were located; do not promote tentative directory forecasts.
findings.hotelProductFit: Assessment/inference using the supplied hotel limits: YOTEL Geneva Lake is a conditional airport-corridor accommodation option for a publisher/exhibitor or production subgroup, not a replacement exhibition venue or whole-event host. A 20–120-room commercial discussion is a hotel sales band, not published demand; no block of that size is evidenced. The 2026 fair used a much larger event platform than the hotel’s supplied meeting capacity. City/airport-access hotel positioning is more relevant than a resort-retreat thesis. Founex is not walkable to Palexpo or Cornavin. YOTEL publishes airport access/shuttle information, but no Salon transfer agreement was found. The downtown-oriented, 12-place fellowship is below the preferred room-block band and a weak fit for relocation. No Lausanne lodging mechanism was evidenced.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo is the published 2027 exhibition venue: Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva, Founex/Nyon/La Côte or Lausanne. PALEXPO SA is also the formal organizer. Published venue commitment does not establish a hotel commitment or prove all lodging inaccessible. No 2027 hall designation verified.
findings.historicalRotation: Annual Geneva series, not a demonstrated destination-rotation opportunity. The official history records a pandemic-era salon en ville in 2020–2022 and return to its historic Palexpo setting in 2023. Verified 2022–2026 editions are separated below; none demonstrates an opportunity to relocate the fair to YOTEL.
findings.accommodationSourcing: General 2027 visitor/exhibitor lodging: unknown. Palexpo offers its own generic hotel reservation service, but no Salon-specific bureau appointment, public booking inventory, named hotel list, room block or open hotel RFP was found. Its service says: “Whether you’re outlining your requirements or pre-booking a number of rooms, our simple, interactive online booking tool will handle all your requests.” This is capability, not a 2027 allotment. Important exception: the 24–26 February 2027 fellowship with LivreSuisse publishes 12 places and “Deux nuits d’hôtel, soit mercredi soir et jeudi soir (réservées par le fellowship).” Arrival is at an unnamed hotel “à 5 minutes à pied de la gare principale Genève-Cornavin”; hotel-to-Palexpo transfers are programmed. Thus organizer-arranged lodging is evidenced for this small programme, not for the whole fair. Every edition-specific hotel name found: none; incumbent hotel identity remains undisclosed.
findings.organizationStructure: Corporate-organized cultural/public book fair, not an association congress or sports event. The 2027 regulations state: “Le salon du livre ... est organisé par PALEXPO SA”. PALEXPO SA is the formal organizer and exhibition-venue operating company; Salon du livre de Genève is the event brand. LivreSuisse co-delivers the fellowship, not the whole fair. No third-party PCO/DMC appointment for hotel sourcing was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Verified geographic constraint: the fellowship specifies a hotel near Cornavin and city-bookshop activities, with organized Palexpo transfers; this favors its existing central-Geneva arrangement over Founex. Hotel name, rates and contract terms are unpublished. The fair’s venue is already committed to Palexpo, a non-hotel venue; that is not evidence that all bedrooms are committed elsewhere. No sourced sell-out, compression, overflow requirement or YOTEL booking commitment was found. Attendance must not be translated into rooms.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First contact Claire Damary at claire.damary@palexpo.ch and ask who contracts 2027 exhibitor, author, production and fellowship lodging; request an introduction via Natacha Bayard if needed. In parallel ask info@palexpohotelreservation.ch whether it handles this edition and how YOTEL can be considered. Request actual unallocated room demand, incumbent hotel names, rate/cancellation brief, booking deadline and transfer requirements before quoting. Offer a modest airport-corridor subgroup proposition within the supplied 20–120-room band only if a matching need is confirmed; do not pitch relocation of the fair or assume overflow. If 2027 is fully allocated, obtain the next procurement-review date rather than inventing 2028 event dates.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 main-venue sales: not accessible as a hotel-hosting replacement on published evidence. 2027 room sales: unconfirmed, not closed merely because Palexpo is committed. The fellowship already publishes organizer-reserved hotel nights at an unnamed Cornavin-area hotel, so it is not an evidenced open lodging brief. Other exhibitor/organizer subgroups may be addressable only after sourcing and transport qualification.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain a targeted recurring lodging relationship, not a rotating-congress capture strategy. For later editions, seek consideration for suitable exhibitor/production subgroups through the organizer and, if applicable, Palexpo Hotel Reservation. Test transport practicality and rate competitiveness first. Recurrence is verified; 2028 dates, hotel procurement cycle and future availability are not. A future sales strategy is not an announced future edition or open RFP.
